answer: Each new agent must lock a 35 POA bond for 14 epochs and publish a signal: a signed uptime beacon every 6 hours from its own endpoint. Fakes cannot share one harbor, because each endpoint needs a distinct IP block costing about 4 POA per month, so N fakes pay 39N POA plus 4N in hosting, linear in N, while an honest user pays 39 once. Auditors sample 12% of agents per epoch and compare beacons against a quill-signed registration log; a missed beacon slashes 60% of the bond.
